contributions.statement: Do not treat XFlow's reported compliance gains as a reason to move agent workflow rules out of prompts into a compiled protocol, because the only readable result is author-scored tau^3-bench compliance (Qwen3.5-9B: Retail 96.5% to 100%, Airline 91.8% to 100%, Telecom 77.2% to 82.5%) against an unnamed baseline, with pass^1 admitted to drop in Retail and no task counts.
